name: ChronoPsykotik
detailed_description:
Step into the fractured psyche of Dr. Elias Varn, a brilliant theoretical physicist whose groundbreaking experiments have shattered the boundaries of reality—and his own sanity. In ChronoPsykotik, a retro-inspired FPS, you’ll battle through surreal, ever-shifting dimensions born from Elias’ crumbling mind. Wield experimental weapons powered by quantum anomalies, fight nightmarish manifestations of his fears, and unravel the truth behind his descent into madness. Will you escape the abyss, or be consumed by it?

  • Explore mind-bending levels filled with retro-style visuals and relentless action.

  • Face off against grotesque enemies that embody Elias’ fractured thoughts—each one a puzzle of its own.

  • Master a unique arsenal, from plasma-charged shotguns to gravity-defying rifles, as you bend the laws of physics to survive.

  • Uncover a haunting narrative through cryptic notes and distorted memories, piecing together the physicist’s tragic story.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)

  • Processor: 3 GHz Quad-Core CPU
